events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-290 commits are on origin/main
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin; for c in 3199bef d1ff5ca; do git branch -r --contains $c | head -3; git show --stat --format='%h %s' $c | head -12; done; git status -sb | head -3; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; git diff --stat cloud/funnel/worker.js

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find all field references and the uncommitted worker diff
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git grep -n 'pg_community\|pg_next' -- app/src cloud app/scripts | cut -c1-260; git diff cloud/funnel/worker.js | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read /thanks render and card shape scoping
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n 'path === "/thanks"' cloud/funnel/worker.js | head; n=$(grep -n 'path === "/thanks"' cloud/funnel/worker.js | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "${n},$((n+8))p" cloud/funnel/worker.js | cut -c1-400; sed -n 1145,1150p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-200; sed -n 1196,1202p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'shapes\?:\|shape:' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | sed -n 1,20p | cut -c1-160

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pageThanks and card shape gating
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n 'function pageThanks' -A8 cloud/funnel/worker.js | cut -c1-500; awk 'NR>=1100 && NR<=1215 && /id: "d[0-9]-|shapes|onlyShape|forShape|webinar|challenge|rsp"/' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dash scan and probe-shapes setup
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 3199bef d1ff5ca -- app cloud | grep '^+' | grep -c $'—\|–'; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-shapes.mjs | grep -n 'env\|879\|http' | head; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -E ':879[0-9]' | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'
